label: Plant overview
info: The Plant overview page: headline numbers and one card per machine. Each row of nodes is one panel: a timer asks the database a question, a function shapes the answer, and a widget draws it. To change a panel, edit its SQL (the 'Query' function) or its look (the template). Nothing here can change production data: this instance logs in to the database with a restricted user.

name: Plant overview: one row = one panel
info:
Timer -> Query -> Run SQL -> Shape -> Widget.
Double-click any node to change it. Deploy (top right) makes the change live for everyone.

name: Query: kpis
func:
// Headline numbers for the four tiles at the top of the Plant overview page
msg.query = `
WITH plant AS (
  SELECT (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE timezone) AT TIME ZONE timezone) AS day_start
    FROM mf.sites ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1),
st AS (SELECT a.id, CASE WHEN a.last_seen_at IS NULL OR a.last_seen_at < now() - make_interval(secs => COALESCE((SELECT (value #>> '{}')::int FROM mf.settings WHERE key = 'offline_after_seconds'), 30)) THEN 'offline' ELSE a.status END AS eff FROM mf.assets a)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM st)::int AS total,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM st WHERE eff = 'running')::int AS running,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM st WHERE eff IN ('faulted','stopped'))::int AS down_now,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM mf.quality_events q, plant p WHERE q.event_time >= p.day_start AND q.result = 'good')::int AS good,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM mf.quality_events q, plant p WHERE q.event_time >= p.day_start AND q.result <> 'good')::int AS scrap,
       (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND((SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(d.ended_at, now()) - GREATEST(d.started_at, p.day_start)))) / 60.0)::numeric, 1), 0)
          FROM mf.downtime_events d, plant p WHERE COALESCE(d.ended_at, now()) >= p.day_start)::float AS downtime_min,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM mf.maintenance_requests WHERE status = 'open')::int AS open_wr,
       COALESCE((SELECT (value #>> '{}')::float FROM mf.settings WHERE key = 'yield_target_pct'), 95) AS yield_target
`;
msg.params = [];
return msg;

name: Shape for the screen
func:
msg.payload = (msg.payload && msg.payload[0]) || {};
return msg;

name: KPI tiles
Query: machines
func:
// One row per machine: status, latest readings, active order, open downtime (the machine cards)
msg.query = `
SELECT a.asset_code, a.name, a.asset_type, ar.name AS area, CASE WHEN a.last_seen_at IS NULL OR a.last_seen_at < now() - make_interval(secs => COALESCE((SELECT (value #>> '{}')::int FROM mf.settings WHERE key = 'offline_after_seconds'), 30)) THEN 'offline' ELSE a.status END AS status,
       (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('name', sg.signal_name,
                 'value', COALESCE(to_json(sg.last_value_numeric), to_json(sg.last_value_text)),
                 'unit', sg.unit) ORDER BY sg.signal_name), '[]'::json)
          FROM mf.asset_signals sg WHERE sg.asset_id = a.id AND sg.signal_name <> 'cycle_count') AS signals,
       (SELECT json_build_object('order_number', o.order_number, 'part_number', o.part_number,
                 'completed', o.completed_quantity, 'target', o.target_quantity, 'scrap', o.scrap_quantity)
          FROM mf.production_orders o WHERE o.asset_id = a.id AND o.status IN ('released','running')
         ORDER BY o.released_at LIMIT 1) AS "order",
       (SELECT json_build_object('reason', COALESCE(d.reason_description, d.reason_code, 'No reason reported'),
                 'since', d.started_at,
                 'work_request', (SELECT r.request_number FROM mf.maintenance_requests r WHERE r.downtime_event_id = d.id LIMIT 1))
          FROM mf.downtime_events d WHERE d.asset_id = a.id AND d.ended_at IS NULL) AS downtime
  FROM mf.assets a
  LEFT JOIN mf.areas ar ON ar.id = a.area_id
 ORDER BY a.asset_code
`;
msg.params = [];
return msg;

name: Query: stats
func:
// Extra numbers for the Analytics tiles
msg.query = `
WITH plant AS (
  SELECT timezone, (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE timezone) AT TIME ZONE timezone) AS day_start
    FROM mf.sites ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM mf.quality_events e, plant p WHERE e.event_time >= p.day_start AND e.result = 'good')::int AS good,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM mf.quality_events e, plant p WHERE e.event_time >= p.day_start AND e.result <> 'good')::int AS scrap,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM mf.production_orders o, plant p WHERE o.completed_at >= p.day_start)::int AS orders_done,
       (SELECT ROUND((AVG(d.duration_seconds) / 60.0)::numeric, 1)::float FROM mf.downtime_events d, plant p
         WHERE d.ended_at >= p.day_start AND d.duration_seconds IS NOT NULL) AS mttr_min,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM mf.downtime_events d, plant p WHERE COALESCE(d.ended_at, now()) >= p.day_start)::int AS stops,
       COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(d.ended_at, now()) - GREATEST(d.started_at, p.day_start))) / 60.0)::numeric, 1)::float
                   FROM mf.downtime_events d, plant p WHERE COALESCE(d.ended_at, now()) >= p.day_start), 0) AS longest_min,
       (SELECT a.asset_code FROM mf.downtime_events d JOIN mf.assets a ON a.id = d.asset_id, plant p
         WHERE COALESCE(d.ended_at, now()) >= p.day_start
         ORDER BY (COALESCE(d.ended_at, now()) - GREATEST(d.started_at, p.day_start)) DESC LIMIT 1) AS longest_machine
`;
msg.params = [];
return msg;

Query: alerts
func:
// Machines that are down right now (the red banner)
msg.query = `
SELECT a.asset_code, a.name, d.status,
       COALESCE(d.reason_description, d.reason_code, 'No reason reported') AS reason,
       d.started_at, r.request_number AS work_request, r.assigned_to
  FROM mf.downtime_events d
  JOIN mf.assets a ON a.id = d.asset_id
  LEFT JOIN mf.maintenance_requests r ON r.downtime_event_id = d.id
 WHERE d.ended_at IS NULL
   AND d.status IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(value) FROM mf.settings WHERE key = 'alert_statuses')
 ORDER BY d.started_at
`;
msg.params = [];
return msg;

name: Alert banner
Query: chart_output
func:
// Good and scrap parts per hour, last 12 hours (plant time)
msg.query = `
WITH plant AS (
  SELECT timezone, (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE timezone) AT TIME ZONE timezone) AS day_start
    FROM mf.sites ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1)
, hrs AS (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('hour', now() AT TIME ZONE timezone) - interval '11 hours',
                                 date_trunc('hour', now() AT TIME ZONE timezone), interval '1 hour') AS h, timezone FROM plant)
SELECT to_char(hrs.h, 'HH24:00') AS hour,
       COALESCE(SUM((e.result = 'good')::int), 0)::int AS good,
       COALESCE(SUM((e.result <> 'good')::int), 0)::int AS scrap
  FROM hrs LEFT JOIN mf.quality_events e ON date_trunc('hour', e.event_time AT TIME ZONE hrs.timezone) = hrs.h
 GROUP BY hrs.h ORDER BY hrs.h
`;
msg.params = [];
return msg;

name: Query: chart_yield
func:
// First-pass yield by machine today (machines with no output yet are left out)
msg.query = `
WITH plant AS (
  SELECT timezone, (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE timezone) AT TIME ZONE timezone) AS day_start
    FROM mf.sites ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1)
SELECT a.asset_code,
       ROUND((100.0 * SUM((e.result = 'good')::int) / NULLIF(COUNT(e.id), 0))::numeric, 1)::float AS yield
  FROM mf.assets a
  JOIN mf.quality_events e ON e.asset_id = a.id
  JOIN plant p ON e.event_time >= p.day_start
 GROUP BY a.asset_code ORDER BY a.asset_code
`;
msg.params = [];
return msg;

name: Shape for the screen
func:
msg.payload = (msg.payload || []).map((r) => ({ x: r.asset_code, y: r.yield, series: 'First-pass yield %' }));
return msg;

name: Query: downtime
func:
// Minutes of downtime today for each machine
msg.query = `
WITH plant AS (
  SELECT (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE timezone) AT TIME ZONE timezone) AS day_start
    FROM mf.sites ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1)
SELECT a.asset_code,
       COALESCE(ROUND((SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(d.ended_at, now()) - GREATEST(d.started_at, p.day_start)))) / 60.0)::numeric, 1), 0)::float AS minutes,
       COUNT(d.id)::int AS events,
       MODE() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.reason_code) AS top_reason
  FROM mf.assets a
  CROSS JOIN plant p
  LEFT JOIN mf.downtime_events d ON d.asset_id = a.id AND COALESCE(d.ended_at, now()) >= p.day_start
 GROUP BY a.asset_code
 ORDER BY a.asset_code
`;
msg.params = [];
return msg;

name: What this editor is
info: This is YOUR Node-RED. It controls what the dashboard shows and the Settings page. The plant's engine (collecting machine data, counting parts, raising alerts, the REST API) runs in a separate, locked instance maintained by us, so a mistake here can never stop production data being collected.

name: Change what a panel shows
info: Open the 'Plant overview' tab. Double-click the 'Query' function in the row for that panel and edit the SQL. Click Deploy.

name: Change how a panel looks
info: Double-click the template (or table) node at the end of the row. Colours and layout live there; the brand theme is under the dashboard sidebar > Theme.

name: Add a new panel
info: Copy a row (select, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V), change the SQL, change the widget's group. Tables are the easiest: any SQL that returns rows becomes a table.

name: Safe by design
info: This instance connects to the database as a restricted user: it can read everything, but only write settings, fault codes and the machine list. Production counts, orders and alerts are written by the locked engine only.
